description: Release gate thresholds for the Ren release workflow. A release fails when any gate falls below its threshold.

automated_gate.description: Fast, deterministic contract tests that run in CI without Resolve or heavy ML dependencies.

manual_steps.name: golden projects
manual_steps.why: Golden project tests render real media with ffmpeg and run the full pipeline (4+ minutes each). Run tests/scenarios/test_golden_monologue.py and tests/scenarios/test_golden_conversation.py on a development machine.

manual_steps.name: ren eval
manual_steps.why: Requires a pristine base project (footage plus analysis) that lives outside git, and a live Resolve. Run per ren eval howto.

manual_steps.name: Resolve-live tests
manual_steps.why: Require the live DaVinci Resolve application with scripting enabled. Run tests/qualification/test_golden_conversation_live.py on a machine with Resolve.

manual_steps.name: render QA
manual_steps.why: Requires a rendered export from a live Resolve timeline. Run render_qa.py against a delivered reel.
